mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School with a Waning Gibbous moon. Also, look to the sky at 5:07 AM to see the ISS passing from the northwest over Middleton and Verona High School toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The city has two important updates: first, winter alternate-side parking rules are in effect from November 20 to April 1 to assist with snow removal. Second, the Water Utility is conducting cross-connection inspections to keep our drinking supply safe, so please watch your mail for a scheduling letter.

We have a busy couple of days! Today features the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event and live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol and more live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly look at police activity, on October 25, an officer found a 40-year-old man asleep behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. If you are planning a visit, please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
